requirements: One reviewed versioned editorial context for all users
Use approved applicability rules; never derive context from a requesting user's location
Resolve the canonical Panchang context before supplying an eligible pool
Approved relevance and eligibility before duplicate control
Complete-history unused-first exclusion before compatible repeat restrictions
An authorized editor must supply the complete versioned order and resolve ties
No AI-assigned weights, default order, annual reset, arbitrary reuse or manufactured fallback

scheduler.recovery: Retry the same date-scoped idempotency key and reread persisted state; never assume a failed response means rollback.
